name: guess-search
author: Essam Gouda
description: Self-taught + look-ahead with a guess net of its own, trained only on its own games: it imagines 256 hidden deals per card from where the guess net thinks each card is, kept by how well they fit the bids.
method: the net keeps its top 2 cards
imagine hidden hands from its own guess net, keep those that fit the bids x256
each kept card: play all 4 seats to the end of the round
